name: PS1-550202 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Type Ia supernova PS1-550202, seen by Hubble.
label: ps1j550202-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field shone PS1-550202, a Type Ia supernova found by the Pan-STARRS survey. Hubble followed it to measure a precise cosmic distance and help trace the expansion history of the universe.

claims.text: PS1-550202 is a Type Ia supernova
Hubble program 13046 (RAISIN) observed the target PS1-J550202
The program followed Type Ia supernovae found in Pan-STARRS fields to measure precise cosmic distances and the cosmic expansion history
